# ADJOA’s  Cuisine

Adjoa's Cuisine is a warm and authentic African food restaurant based in Ho, Bentota, offering a rich variety of beloved West African dishes including Jollof Rice, Tilapia with Banku, Fried Yam, and more. The brand celebrates the hearty, flavorful traditions of African home cooking, serving customers around the clock with a convenient 24-hour delivery service. The restaurant blends comfort food culture with accessibility, making authentic African cuisine available at any time of day.

Source: https://example.com

Why We're Special

## The Heart ofAdjoa's Cuisine


Bringing the warmth of West African kitchens to your table, every hour of the day. From our homestyle recipes to our lightning-fast delivery, discover what makes us Ho's favorite destination for authentic, comforting food.












### Homestyle African Cooking


Every dish is crafted from cherished family recipes passed down through generations. We use fresh, quality ingredients to bring you the bold, comforting flavors of West Africa — just like home.











### All-Day Delivery Convenience


Craving comfort food at midnight? We've got you covered. Our 24-hour delivery service ensures your favorite meals reach you fresh and fast, anywhere in Ho, Bentota — day or night.











### Beloved Everyday Favorites


From Jollof Rice to Fried Yam and Tilapia with Banku, our menu is packed with crowd-pleasers. Perfect for families, food explorers, and anyone seeking a satisfying, soulful meal.















## Signature Taste, Anytime


From the bold spices of Jollof to the hearty comfort of Fried Yam, every dish is a celebration of authentic West African home cooking — delivered to your door, 24 hours a day.

# The Heart of Adjoa's Cuisine


At Adjoa’s Cuisine, we believe that food is more than just a meal — it’s a homecoming. Rooted in the rich, vibrant traditions of West African home cooking, our kitchen brings the warmth of a family table to Ho, Bentota. Every dish is a celebration of heritage, crafted with love and the freshest ingredients to deliver the authentic taste of Africa.


From our signature Jollof Rice to the perfectly paired Tilapia with Banku, our mission is simple: keep the beloved flavors of home accessible, any hour of the day. Whether you're craving a late-night comfort dish or a festive family platter, our 24-hour delivery ensures that a taste of home is never far away.














## Our Story


From our kitchen to your table — a journey of flavor, tradition, and love.







1


### Rooted in Tradition


Adjoa’s Cuisine was born from generations of West African home cooking. Every recipe we serve carries the soul of family gatherings, festive celebrations, and the unmistakable aroma of Jollof rice simmering over an open flame. We honor the past by bringing authentic, time-tested dishes to the heart of Ho, Bentota.






2


### Made for Everyday Cravings


We believe comfort food should be accessible. Whether it’s crispy Fried Yam, hearty Banku with Tilapia, or a quick plate of savory Indomie, our menu is crafted for your daily moments. Just like the great wall chinese restaurant experience, we focus on consistency, warmth, and flavors that feel like home.






3


### Available Whenever Hunger Calls


Hunger doesn’t keep office hours, and neither do we. With our 24-hour delivery service, you can enjoy authentic African cuisine anytime — late-night cravings, early-morning feasts, or holiday gatherings. We’re proud to be among the restaurants open on thanksgiving and every other day of the year, bringing the feast to your doorstep.











## Our Core Values


The heart and soul behind every dish we serve. Rooted in tradition, driven by love.











### Authenticity


We honor centuries-old recipes passed down through generations. Every ingredient is sourced to deliver the true, unadulterated taste of West Africa — just like grandma used to make.










### Flavor Generosity


We believe in bold, abundant flavors. No skimping on spices, no cutting corners. Our generous portions and rich seasonings ensure every meal is a celebration of taste.










### Accessibility


Great food shouldn't wait. With our 24-hour delivery service across Ho and Bentota, authentic African cuisine is always just a call away — hot, fresh, and ready when you are.










### Community Comfort


Adjoa's is more than a restaurant — it's a home. We create a warm, welcoming space where friends and families gather to share stories, laughter, and the comforting taste of home.

















What Our Customers Say


## Loved by Food Lovers Across the Community


From diaspora families craving a taste of home to food explorers discovering the richness of West African cuisine, our customers share their love for the warmth, flavor, and convenience that define Adjoa's Cuisine.

# Adjoa's Cuisine — Delivery & Dining


Experience the warmth of West African home cooking delivered to your doorstep in Ho, Bentota, 24 hours a day. We bring the bold, hearty flavors of Jollof Rice, Tilapia with Banku, Fried Yam, and more directly to you — ensuring every meal is a celebration of authentic African culinary tradition, available whenever the craving strikes.











## 24-Hour Delivery, Anytime Cravings


Your favorite African comfort food never sleeps. Whether it's a late-night Jollof Rice craving or an early-morning order of Fried Yam and Pork, our dedicated delivery team is on standby around the clock. We serve Ho and Bentota with the same speed and care, making us one of the most reliable restaurants open on thanksgiving and every other day of the year.




059 901 4008



059 181 2885













## Hearty Meals, Always Available


From the rich, smoky depth of our signature Jollof Rice to the satisfying crunch of Fried Yam Chips and the comforting warmth of Boiled Yam with Pork and Fish, our full menu is ready when you are. We pride ourselves on being a destination for genuine African comfort food, rivaling the experience of michelin star restaurants with our dedication to flavor, freshness, and homestyle preparation.


Explore Our Full Menu












## Local Convenience in Ho, Bentota


Located around Lizz Dee in Ho, Bentota, Adjoa's Cuisine brings the best of West Africa to your neighborhood. Whether you're dining in or ordering delivery, we make it easy to enjoy dishes like Spaghetti, Sorted Indomie, and Tilapia with Banku without the wait. Much like the convenience of a cn tower restaurant with a view, we focus on making every meal memorable — right from the comfort of your home.



Ho, Bentota (around Lizz Dee), Ho, Ghana















## Why Dine With Adjoa's


Experience the heart of West African cuisine, delivered to your doorstep any time of day or night. We bring the warmth of home-cooked meals straight to you.









### 24-Hour Delivery


Craving authentic African cuisine at midnight? We're open around the clock. Whether it's a late-night snack or an early morning feast, our kitchen is ready to serve you, any hour of the day.








### Family-Style Portions


Food brings people together. Our generous, shareable platters are perfect for family dinners and group gatherings. From Jollof Rice to Fried Yam, everyone gets a taste of home.








### Hearty & Satisfying


No skimping here. We believe in big flavors and even bigger portions. Our Tilapia with Banku and Fried Yam dishes are crafted to satisfy the heartiest of appetites, just like home.








### Easy Direct Ordering


Skip the apps and talk to us directly. Call or WhatsApp us to place your order instantly. We're here to make your experience seamless, personal, and hassle-free.











## A Taste of Home, Any Time of Day


From sizzling Jollof Rice to perfectly fried Tilapia with Banku, every dish tells a story of West African tradition — delivered fresh to your door in Ho, Bentota, 24 hours a day.

## Frequently Asked Questions


Everything you need to know about our delivery, dishes, and dining experience.










### What are your delivery hours?


We offer 24-hour delivery service across Ho and Bentota, so you can enjoy authentic African cuisine anytime — day or night.











### How can I contact you?


Call us at 059 901 4008 or WhatsApp 059 181 2885. You can also visit us near Lizz Dee in Ho, Bentota.











### Where are you located?


We're at HO, BENTOTA AROUND LIZZ DEE. Find us easily on the map or look for the warm red signage.











### What dishes do you offer?


We serve Jollof Rice, Fried Yam, Tilapia with Banku, Spaghetti, Sorted Indomie, Boiled Yam, Yam Chips, and more.











### Is your food halal?


We prepare our dishes with care and tradition. Please contact us directly for specific dietary certifications and ingredient details.











### Do you cater for events?


Yes! We cater for parties, corporate events, and family gatherings. Call us to discuss a custom menu for your special occasion.

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 6/9/2026



At ADJOA’s Cuisine, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: comfortxewudor@gmail.com


Phone: 0599014008


Address: Ho, Bentota (around Lizz Dee), Ghana

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/9/2026



ADJOA’s Cuisine ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: ADJOA’s Cuisine

- Email: comfortxewudor@gmail.com

- Phone: 0599014008

- Address: Ho, Bentota (around Lizz Dee), Ghana



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 9, 2026



ADJOA’s Cuisine is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: ADJOA’s Cuisine

- Email: comfortxewudor@gmail.com

- Phone: 0599014008



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

# Terms of Use

## 1. Definitions


- "Company" - ADJOA’s Cuisine

- "User" - Anyone who browses or uses the site

- "Services" - Restaurant provided through the site




## 2. Description of Services


ADJOA’s Cuisine provides Restaurant through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.


## 3. Terms of Use


Use of the site is conditional on compliance with the following terms:


- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- Respect for copyright and intellectual property rights

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations


- Providing accurate and truthful information during registration or ordering

- Payments are processed through secure and encrypted systems

## 8. Privacy


Collection and use of personal information is subject to our Privacy Policy. Use of the site constitutes agreement to the Privacy Policy as detailed separately.


## 9. Changes to Terms of Use


The Company may change these terms of use at any time. Material changes will be posted on the site with 30 days advance notice. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement to the new terms.


## 10. Service Termination


The Company may suspend or limit service at any time, including in cases of terms of use violations. In case of service termination, relevant provisions will remain in effect.


## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.
